candidates.name: CityJSON
verified_facts: CityJSON is a JSON-based data exchange format for digital 3D models of cities and landscapes.
It implements a subset of the CityGML 3.0 data model and includes a JSON-specific extension mechanism.
semantic_limits: A 3D city-model encoding can carry geometry but does not by itself establish source survey accuracy, ground classification or parcel elevation uncertainty.

candidates.name: Indoor Mapping Data Format (IMDF)
verified_facts: IMDF provides a generalized model for indoor locations supporting orientation, navigation and discovery.
The specification includes detailed modelling guidance for indoor venues such as airports, shopping malls and train stations.
semantic_limits: Indoor venue geometry and floor-space modelling are not evidence of outdoor parcel ground elevation or DTM vertical accuracy.
